data.body:
[P2] Preserve caller-key precedence for non-plain object messages

If a class-instance message has an enumerable `operationName: "caller"` property, logging it inside a named step takes this branch. Powertools merges `durableData` after the message attributes, replacing the caller's value with the step name. The equivalent plain-object message preserves the caller's value, so precedence unexpectedly depends on the object's prototype. Before appending metadata, omit keys already supplied as enumerable attributes on the input, while retaining the original input object. Add a real-Powertools regression test covering a class instance with a conflicting key.
